subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: After a clean rebase, should maintainers accept this helper-side group-leader check and explicit detached caller audit as the process-tree cleanup contract for omitted `detached` calls?
rationale: The patch fixes a real availability bug but changes default semantics in an exported process-tree helper, so a human should own the compatibility/availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept after clean rebase
options.body: Rebase the branch, preserve current-main process cleanup changes, rerun focused validation, and land this contract if no new conflicts or failures appear.

options.title: Require opt-in group kill instead
options.body: Ask for a narrower design where omitted `detached` never group-kills and every group-kill caller must pass explicit spawn-time detachment state.

options.title: Pause for broader process API design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want to redesign `killProcessTree` as a stricter internal API before changing helper defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept after clean rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, preserve current-main process cleanup changes, rerun focused validation, and land this contract if no new conflicts or failures appear.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-core/process history and broad runtime refactor ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
